claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the oil makes their skin soft, hydrated, and glowing, often using it as a base before makeup.
Many reviewers praise the pleasant scent, though a few note it smells like oranges or fruity and dissipates.
Several reviewers say it improves foundation application, making makeup go on smoother and less caked or powdery.
A few reviewers mention it can look too oily if over-applied or cause minor breakouts with frequent use.
One reviewer complains it is not actually rosehip oil, calling it false advertising, though still hydrating.
